question: Salman starts from his office and drives 29 km towards South. Then he turns right and drives 16 km, again he turns right and drives 29 km. Finally he turns right and drives 13 km. At what distance is he from his start point in a straight line?
solution:
Given: 

Salman starts from his office and drives 29 km towards South. 

he turns right and drives 16 km.

again, he turns right and drives 29 km.

Finally, he turns right and drives 13 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b73312cfecd6890e9462465a2e7de222a41533f29ed4e998c9085e3ef3d4e35.png] 

Thus, distance from start pointing in a straight line is "3 km".

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
